resources.string: Imodi ye-BlackBerry ishintsha ukunyakaza, izinqamuleli zekhibhodi, imisindo nezimemezelo ngalokho okufana nalokho kwesifundi sesikrini se-BlackBerry 10. Kungenzeka ukuthi ngeke ukujwayele uma ungakaze uyisebenzise i-BlackBerry 10. Ukuze uyivale, iya ku-Amasethingi weSandFly > Amaphrofayili ezilungiselelo > Imodi ye-BlackBerry.

Ukunyakaza kwe-BlackBerry kufana nokunyakaza kwesifundi sesikrini se-BlackBerry 10. Kungenzeka ukuthi ngeke ukujwayele uma ungakaze uyisebenzise i-BlackBerry 10. Ukuze ubuyele emuva, setha Ukunyakaza > Isakhiwo sokunyakaza sibe ngu-Ukunyakaza kwe-SandFly.
